messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's identity to match the person in the reference photo. Match the reference person's facial features and adjust the body's skin tone accordingly. Do not copy the hairstyle, hair color, or expression from the reference photo. Preserve all other aspects of the current video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please use the video that was the input to the first hairstyle change as the starting point, and make the following change: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the person's identity to match the person in the reference photo. Match the reference person's facial features and adjust the body's skin tone accordingly. Do not copy the hairstyle, hair color, or expression from the reference photo. Preserve all other aspects of the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"She stands on a cobblestone street, turning from a side profile to face away from the camera, raising one arm to touch her hair while resting the other hand on her hip, then turning back toward the front.","camera":"A static, medium full-body shot at eye level that keeps the woman centered in the frame.","clothing":"A white one-piece romper with a pink, purple, and yellow floral print, three-quarter sleeves, and a low open back, paired with pink lace-up flat shoes.","hair_color":"Light silver-gray.","hairstyle":"Short, wavy hair with bangs, gathered into a small low bun at the nape.","identity":"A slender, light-skinned woman with a slim build, shown in profile and from behind.","scene":"A narrow cobblestone street lined with old European-style brick and stone buildings, black lampposts, and hanging signs, including a Union Jack flag on the left."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The woman's face and body skin tone became noticeably darker, closer to the reference person's tone. Her facial features appear altered in the brief frontal views, though the face is mostly in profile or turned away. The silver-gray hair, bun, floral romper, pink shoes, street scene, camera framing, and turning motion remain essentially the same.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's identity to match the reference photo, including facial features and body skin tone, while preserving the current hairstyle, hair color, expression, clothing, scene, and motion.
uncertain: Whether the facial features specifically match the reference person, because the face is mostly in profile or turned away and only briefly visible from the front.
